evidence: Simulated from stated geometry; not validated against a physical robot.

model.architecture: base yaw plus shoulder, elbow and wrist pitch
model.branchSelection: minimum |shoulder pitch| + |elbow pitch|; no joint stops

limitations: The 71 points represent an illustrative 2278 x 1134 mm panel and 300 mm standoff, not measured feed.
Task points are projected into a radial vertical plane and base yaw is solved separately.
No collision, joint limits, actuator curves, deflection, backlash, repeatability, tool pose, speed or acceleration are included.
Payload torque excludes links, wrist, tool, acceleration, friction, duty and design factors.
This is not a robot selection or safe motion plan.
